truly cannot say enough amazing things about my stay at The Ocean Club Resort in Sosúa for my 30th birthday—it was nothing short of perfect from start to finish.

Every morning felt like a dream. We started our days slowly, enjoying the most delicious fresh Caribbean fruit and warm, freshly baked pastries in the most peaceful, relaxing setting overlooking the mountains across the island. It was the kind of place that forces you to slow down and actually enjoy every moment.

The highlight of the trip was hands down my private birthday dinner on the beach. The setup was absolutely stunning, complete with beautiful birthday balloon décor that made it feel so personal and special. Not another soul in site other than the chef and wait staff. The food was incredible, and the entire experience felt like something out of a movie.

The service throughout our stay was exceptional. The waiters and waitresses were beyond fabulous—so warm, attentive, and genuinely kind (shout out to Yohanny, she is the sweetest soul and took such good care of us every morning at breakfast). The front desk staff went above and beyond to make sure everything was seamless. They were incredibly accommodating and truly made us feel valued and welcomed every step of the way.

We were also lucky enough to receive a room upgrade, and it completely exceeded our expectations. Our luxurious three-bedroom suite was stunning—spacious, beautifully designed, and the perfect place to celebrate such a special occasion. I mean… I could shower while looking at ocean! No windows, just a wide open door overlooking the beautiful island hills, water, and beach. 

The resort made everything effortless. Airport pickup and drop-off were flawlessly arranged, and we had a private driver who is employed by the hotel for the entire week, which made getting to / from dinner and exploring so easy and stress-free.
